description: This file defines the DynamicViewEntity class, which is responsible for constructing and managing dynamic view entity configurations in Apache OFBiz. It includes methods for adding entity members, aliases, view links, relations, and generating XML representations of the view entity structure.

classes.name: DynamicViewEntity
classes.description: Represents a dynamic view entity in OFBiz, allowing configuration of entity members, aliases, view links, relations, and exporting the configuration as XML.

methods.name: makeModelViewEntity
methods.description: Creates a ModelViewEntity object based on the current DynamicViewEntity configuration.

methods.name: getViewXml
methods.description: Generates the XML string representation of the view entity definition.

methods.name: getViewElement
methods.description: Constructs XML DOM elements representing the view entity structure.

methods.name: getOneRealEntityName
methods.description: Returns the entity name of the first member entity.

methods.name: addMemberEntity
methods.description: Adds a member entity with an alias and entity name to the view configuration.

methods.name: addAliasAll
methods.description: Adds an alias-all configuration with optional prefix and exclusions.

methods.name: addAllAliasAllsToList
methods.description: Appends all alias-all configurations to an external list.

methods.name: addAlias
methods.description: Adds an alias for an entity with various optional parameters like field, colAlias, primary key, group by, and functions.

methods.name: addAllAliasesToList
methods.description: Appends all added aliases to an external list.

methods.name: addViewLink
methods.description: Defines a view link relationship between entities, with variants accepting different parameters.

methods.name: makeViewEntityCondition
methods.description: Creates a ViewEntityCondition object based on provided parameters or XML elements for use in view links.

methods.name: addAllViewLinksToList
methods.description: Appends all view links to an external list.

methods.name: addRelation
methods.description: Defines a relation between this entity and another.

methods.name: addAllRelationsToList
methods.description: Appends all relations to an external list.

methods.name: setGroupBy
methods.description: Sets the group-by fields for the view entity.

methods.name: addAllGroupByFieldsToList
methods.description: Adds group-by fields to an external list.
